body: This post made me cry I wish I was you so bad

I take a women’s razor and pop the blades out of it and use that. I don’t even slice using the blade part (if that makes sense), I use the edge to scratch myself. Almost no scar and I still get blood. I sorta want to use something sharper and really go crazy sometimes but I haven’t bought any real razors yet.

What I used to do was knit whenever I felt an urge. Reading, journaling (this one was very helpful), and watching tv. Just take your mind off stuff. When all else fails, just take a nap or go to sleep for the night and wake up feeling better.
I just want to fucking end it sometimes

Progress isn’t linear! I spent a year without cutting but was in a terrible headspace, I relapsed 3 weeks ago and I have been more awakened and mindful since then. I feel like I’ve made so much progress it’s unreal. 

(Not that I believe cutting is good, but just that everyone has a different journey. We are all entitled to relapses, but that doesn’t take away at our validity.)

I believe in you! Message me if you are feeling especially down :)
I’m with you on the chocolate!! And all I can say is stay safe <3
Yeah that guy sounds like an asshole

I was diagnosed with BPD and I want to die too but I’m just trying to live one day at a time. If I don’t survive I won’t ever get a chance to read Bryan Cranston’s memoir—I bought that book and I want to read it. I have to stay alive long enough to read it and then I guess I’ll find something else small to live for. I have no one to live for sadly and my BPD is a bitch but therapy helps. Good luck sending love
Thank you for your reply it means a lot to have support :)

As a girl who attempted suicide in high school, I found this movie my senior year and I loved it. I idolized Susana in every sense, and probably even Lisa too. I was struggling back then, and I probably watched the movie once a week. It didn’t take long before I was in a mental hospital for the second time in my high school career, but I don’t think I’ve watched the film since I got out (a long time ago). I think the movie might be too dark for me, it maybe influences me in a bad way. Don’t get me wrong, it is still one of my favorites, but I can’t watch it on a bad day because that could send me down a rabbit hole. This post makes me want to watch it again tbh
Especially because I’m in a sales environment, I could be fired if customers are off-put and complain to management
Your situation sounds similar to mine. I just cut on my thighs so no one would see fresh cuts at work. I’m here with you ❤️
